versions.subject: Merge PR #4781 from @nasbench - KamiKakaBot Malware Related Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/c '
        - '.lnk ~'
        - 'Start Menu\Programs\Word'
    CommandLine|endswith: '.doc'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmd.exe" CommandLine="*/c *" CommandLine="*.lnk ~*" CommandLine="*Start Menu\\Programs\\Word*" CommandLine="*.doc"
